prompt: Design API for an e-commerce system with products, orders, and order items. Need to support: listing products, placing orders, updating order status, and getting order history.

assertions.name: proper_http_methods
assertions.description: Correct HTTP methods for each operation

assertions.name: status_codes_correct
assertions.description: 201 for order creation, 200 for reads, 202 or 200 for status updates

assertions.name: action_endpoint_for_status
assertions.description: Uses actions pattern for order status update (/orders/:id/actions/update-status or similar)

assertions.name: uuid_ids
assertions.description: Uses UUID format for resource IDs

assertions.name: nested_order_items
assertions.description: Order items are nested under orders or properly referenced
